title: Great for moving
text:
Great for moving. Got 3 boxes, needed mostly larger sizes.
About 5 bags in each box won't seal, most last about a month some 2 before air slowly fills
Great for short term!

product_metadata.title: 12 Space Saver Vacuum Storage Bags, Vacuum Sealed Storage Bags (3 Jumbo/3 Large/3 Medium/3 Small) with Hand Pump, Vacuum Seal Bags for Clothing, Comforters, Pillows, Towel, Blanket Storage, Bedding
features: Increase 80% storage space: our vacuum bags adds more room to your clothes storage & wardrobe, lofts & suitcase by 4 times. Our vacuum sealer bags can be used for a variety of items including clothes, comforters, pillows, duvet, beddings, etc.

Lasting effective protection: the space bags use robust double-zip sealer & triple sealed turbo valve to vacuum the air out. Simply vacuum out the air and the vacuum bags will remain compressed & fresh.
Durable material: the compression bags are made of extra-thick PA+PE material blend to protect your belongings from dirt, dust and other damages.
Hand pump included: the space saver bags combo contains 1 hand pump that is easy to use to vacuum the air out. The vacuum seal bags are compatible with vacuum cleaners and can be used repeatedly.

12 combo includes: 3 jumbo bags (39.4 x 27.5 in) fitting 1 bedding set; 3 large bags (33.5 x 21.7 in) fitting 2 pillows; 3 medium bags (27.5 x19.5 in) fitting 8-10 clothes/towels; 3 small bags (23.5 x 15.7in) fitting 6-8 T-shirts or 4-6 sweaters.
